title: Wind Could Cut the Cost of Round-the-Clock Solar Power by 18%, Ember Says
body: A new report from Ember Energy shows the enormous cost-saving potential of wind energy. While solar power and battery storage have taken off on a global level, wind power has been slower to expand. But according to the new report from the prominent energy think tank, this is a major missed opportunity for energy security, emissions goals, and economic returns.
